title: The Shooting Gallery
text: Masked crossbowmen lean from a gallery above the street, laughing behind their blank faces as they shoot at anyone who walks below. The cobbles bristle with bolts. The street is the only way through.

options.label: The one who draws every bolt runs the street first, so the rest may follow.

outcomes.text: Every bolt goes after them and misses. The masks applaud.

options.label: The one with the poorest eye walks it slowly, unafraid of what they cannot see.

outcomes.text: The masks are so puzzled that they forget to shoot.

options.label: The one with the hurt arm holds a shield over the rest, since it is hurt already.

outcomes.text: The rest cross under cover. The shield bearer catches up last, bruised, the shield full of bolts.
